rule.description: ACF2Logonid entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the ACF2 Account entitlement with the Identity Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in ACF2 if the user is not entitled to an account in ACF2. Modify or remove this rule if you want entitlement policy to apply to matching accounts in ACF2. Notice that this may result in the ACF2 account being deleted or disabled.
